verdict.rationale: Kick's own MCP/CLI surface is described as letting users "build workflows that run across every workspace", and its rules apply automatically to every matching transaction. Together these give some ability to act on many items at once, but nothing documents an explicit bulk-select or bulk-edit operation over existing items. Missing for 10: a documented bulk edit, recategorize, or delete over a selected set of existing transactions; documented batch semantics or limits in the MCP/CLI/API; hands-on corroboration.
